### David's Lord
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/davids-lord
Passage: Matthew 22:41-45
Points:
- Jesus turns from fielding traps to examining the Pharisees regarding the true lineage of the Messiah.
- The religious leaders accurately cite Old Testament prophecies showing that the Messiah would be David's physical descendant.
- By citing Psalm 110, Jesus demonstrates that David himself, inspired by the Holy Spirit, acknowledged the Messiah as his Lord.
- The Messiah cannot be reduced to merely a mortal king, because He shares God's own divine throne and authority.
- Genuine faith rests on confessing Christ as both David's son in human history and David's eternal Lord.

### Praying the Names of God - April 28
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-may-8.html
Passage: Mark 12:35-37
Points:
- People frequently place unrealistic expectations on political leaders to resolve deep societal problems.
- First-century Israelites similarly longed for an earthly Son of David to defeat Rome and restore national glory.
- Jesus cited David's declaration to reveal that the Messiah far exceeds David in power, identity, and authority.
- The fundamental human dilemma requires more than political reform; it demands redemption and victory over sin.
- Jesus reigns as the divine King who alone can conquer our ultimate spiritual enemies.
